notes.title: Fixed problems for keyboard and mouse use
notes.notes:
Thanks to your first reports, we were able to quickly resolve the following:
-Locking pointer in windowed and full screen mode.
-Allow to equip / disequip armor with "up arrow".
-Allow to change item with "down arrow".
-Allow to reset "pause menu" and "inventory" (exiting and re opening)
  if the user accidentally clicks the mouse while they are open.
-Allow to pause game without "onscreen menu" to make it easier to send reports with screenshoots.

In addition to listening to fix what is wrong and improve what you like, in the coming weeks we will be dedicated to
-Improve the graphics / framerate ratio.
- recruit some voice actors to enrich the plot.
-to give a general retouch to the sound system.
Thanks again for your trust! We weren't expecting much enthusiasm.

notes.title: EARLY ACCES RELEASE
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the early release of "FIRST HERO - Epic of Gilgamesh" on March 31th.
We hope to excite you, but also to listen to numerous suggestions. We remind you that in the first week there will be an 18% discount and numerous updates in the coming months.
Thank you very much for the enormous support.
